name: kalks-monorepo
description: KALKS trading platform: marketing site (apps/web), trader app (apps/trader) and back-office admin (apps/admin)

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n trader,admin,web -c green,magenta,blue "npm run dev:trader" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:trader && npm run build:admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:trader && npm run lint:admin
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/trader ci && npm --prefix apps/admin ci
